stories.title: Flintshire veteran support groups can apply for share of £50m UK funding
stories.summary: Flintshire-based organisations supporting armed forces veterans can now apply for UK Government grants of between £200,000 and £1m to join a new £50m national support network. stories.title: Bellway offering up to £20,000 incentives on new homes in Deeside
stories.summary: Housebuilder Bellway is offering incentives worth up to £20,000 on selected new homes at its Summers Bridge development in Deeside until the end of May. stories.title: EastEnders’ Charlie Brooks to star in Curious Incident at Storyhouse Chester
stories.summary: Charlie Brooks and Joe McFadden will lead the cast of The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-time when the UK tour reaches Storyhouse Chester in March 2027. The production runs from Tuesday 16 March to Saturday 20 March 2027, with tickets from £28.50 for Storyhouse Members. General ticket prices have not been announced.

stories.title: Theatr Clwyd CEO named IoD Wales Director of the Year for Sustainability
stories.summary: The Chief Executive of Theatr Clwyd in Mold has been named Director of the Year for Sustainability at the IoD Wales Director of the Year Awards 2026.
